recap.text: Eileithyia tells Katia she will first be made human again, and Katia shrinks, her blonde hair turning black. She is missing her right arm to the shoulder, her left leg, her right leg to the knee, and an ear. Bautista brings the cybernetic parts she built and he finished, and they click them into place under the goddess's hand. Ineligible appears over her head, and Katia waves her cybernetic arm and vanishes in a puff of smoke.

beats.headline: Clicked into place
beats.text: Eileithyia tells Katia she will first be made human again, and Katia shrinks, her blonde hair turning black. Her entire right arm is gone to the shoulder, her left leg is gone, her right leg up to the knee, and an ear. Just a few things she has lost along the way, she says. Bautista quickly brings the cybernetic parts: she made them herself in anticipation of this and left them in the crafting room, and he finished them. They all click and fasten them into place while the goddess lays her hand on Katia's stomach. The word Ineligible appears over her head. Bye, guys, Katia says, raises her cybernetic right arm, waves, and is gone in a puff of smoke.
beats.gist: Katia is made human again, gets her cybernetic limbs fitted, is marked Ineligible, and vanishes waving.
